## alice-mail-attachment-processor (PROJ-53 Iteration 4)

Nightly (02:00) drain of the Redis list `alice:mail:attachment_queue`, which
`alice-mail-sync` fills minutely via `Code: Enqueue Attachment Jobs`.

The attachment pipeline (prefilter -> extension routing -> PDF text ->
LLM classification -> `/attachment` fetch -> NAS write) was moved here 1:1 from
`alice-mail-sync`s former `Code: Import Attachments`, because alice-mail-sync runs
every minute and must not load the DMS model (`OLLAMA_MODEL_DMS`) while the chat
model occupies the GPU.

Queue entries are only removed after they have been handled, so a time-limit abort
or a crash leaves the rest for the next run (same pattern as `alice-dms-processor`
with `alice:dms:plaintext`).

Note: the per-mail thumbnail publish (`alice/dms/done` for the `Email` object
itself) stays in `alice-mail-sync` - it is independent of attachments. The MQTT
node here fires per mail whose attachments produced at least one new NAS file.
